crew.overview: A group of Serbian socialists prepares for the war in a surreal underground filled by parties, tragedies, love and hate.

crew.overview: When an arranged marriage brings Ada and her spirited daughter to the wilderness of nineteenth-century New Zealand, she finds herself locked in a battle of wills with both her controlling husband and a rugged frontiersman to whom she develops a forbidden attraction.
crew.title: The Piano

crew.original_title: Le père Noël est une ordure
crew.overview: Two neurotics, working for a suicide hotline on the night of Christmas Eve, get caught up in a catastrophe when a pregnant woman, her abusive boyfriend, and a transvestite visit their office.
crew.title: Santa Claus Is a Stinker

crew.overview: A middle-aged Tehranian man, Mr. Badii is intent on killing himself and seeks someone to bury him after his demise. Driving around the city, the seemingly well-to-do Badii meets with numerous people, including a Muslim student, asking them to take on the job, but initially he has little luck. Eventually, Badii finds a man who is up for the task because he needs the money, but his new associate soon tries to talk him out of committing suicide.
crew.title: Taste of Cherry

details.biography:
Alain Depardieu, born in Châteauroux in 1945, is a French film executive producer and production manager. He notably collaborated with Claude Berri in the 1990s. He is the brother of Gérard Depardieu.
